messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

You will be given a piece of text and a list of relational triples in the format of [Subject, Relation, Object] extracted from the text. For each relation present in the triples, your task is to write a description to express the meaning of the relation.

Here are some examples:
Example 1:
Text: Lipitor (atorvastatin) belongs to a group of drugs called statins. Lipitor is used together with diet to lower blood levels of "bad" cholesterol (LDL) and to reduce the risk of stroke and heart attack.
Triples: [["Lipitor", "has generic name", "atorvastatin"], ["Lipitor", "belongs to drug class", "statins"], ["Lipitor", "treats", "high LDL cholesterol"], ["Lipitor", "reduces risk of", "stroke"]]
Relations: ["has generic name", "belongs to drug class", "treats", "reduces risk of"]
Answer:
has generic name: The subject drug is known by the generic (non-proprietary) name specified by the object entity.
belongs to drug class: The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological drug class specified by the object entity.
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.
reduces risk of: The subject drug is used to lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.

Example 2:
Text: You should not use metformin if you have severe kidney disease. Tell your doctor if you have ever had liver disease. Metformin may cause lactic acidosis, a serious condition. Avoid drinking alcohol while taking metformin.
Triples: [["metformin", "contraindicated in", "severe kidney disease"], ["metformin", "use with caution in", "liver disease"], ["metformin", "has serious side effect", "lactic acidosis"], ["metformin", "should be avoided with", "alcohol"]]
Relations: ["contraindicated in", "use with caution in", "has serious side effect", "should be avoided with"]
Answer:
contraindicated in: The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
use with caution in: The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition specified by the object entity.
has serious side effect: The subject drug may cause the serious or dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity.
should be avoided with: Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.

Example 3:
Text: Amlodipine is available as oral tablets in strengths of 2.5 mg, 5 mg, and 10 mg. Overdose symptoms may include rapid heartbeats and fainting. Norvasc is made by Pfizer.
Triples: [["amlodipine", "has dosage form", "oral tablet"], ["amlodipine", "has strength", "2.5 mg"], ["amlodipine", "has overdose symptom", "fainting"], ["Norvasc", "manufactured by", "Pfizer"]]
Relations: ["has dosage form", "has strength", "has overdose symptom", "manufactured by"]
Answer:
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.
has strength: The subject drug is available in the dose strength specified by the object entity.
has overdose symptom: An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
manufactured by: The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.

Now please write relation descriptions given the following text and triples. Note that the description needs to be general and can be used to describe relations between other entities as well. Pay attention to the order of subject and object entities. Write exactly one line per relation in the form "relation: description" and nothing else.
Text: Meloxicam is a nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID).
Meloxicam works by reducing hormones that cause pain, fever, and inflammation in the body.
Meloxicam is used to relieve pain, tenderness, swelling, and stiffness.
These symptoms are caused by osteoarthritis and rheumatoid arthritis.
Osteoarthritis is arthritis caused by a breakdown of the lining of the joints.
Rheumatoid arthritis is arthritis caused by swelling of the lining of the joints.
Meloxicam is used to relieve pain, tenderness, swelling, and stiffness.
These symptoms are caused by juvenile rheumatoid arthritis.
Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis is a type of arthritis that affects children.
Meloxicam is used in children 2 years of age and older.
IV meloxicam (brands Anjeso [discontinued], Qamzova, Xifyrm) is used for moderate to severe pain in adults, alone or in combination with non-NSAID analgesics.
Vivlodex capsules [discontinued] are only for use in adults.
Qmiiz ODT (orally disintegrating tablet) [discontinued] is for adults and children weighing at least 132 pounds (60 kilograms).
Generic meloxicam is available.
Triples: [["Meloxicam", "has drug class", "nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug"], ["Meloxicam", "has mechanism of action", "reducing hormones that cause pain, fever, and inflammation"], ["Meloxicam", "treats", "pain"], ["Meloxicam", "treats", "tenderness"], ["Meloxicam", "treats", "swelling"], ["Meloxicam", "treats", "stiffness"], ["Osteoarthritis", "causes", "pain"], ["Osteoarthritis", "causes", "tenderness"], ["Osteoarthritis", "causes", "swelling"], ["Osteoarthritis", "causes", "stiffness"], ["Osteoarthritis", "is type of", "arthritis"], ["Osteoarthritis", "caused by", "breakdown of the lining of the joints"], ["Rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "pain"], ["Rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "tenderness"], ["Rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "swelling"], ["Rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "stiffness"], ["Rheumatoid arthritis", "is type of", "arthritis"], ["Rheumatoid arthritis", "caused by", "swelling of the lining of the joints"], ["Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "pain"], ["Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "tenderness"], ["Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "swelling"], ["Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis", "causes", "stiffness"], ["Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis", "is type of", "arthritis"], ["Juvenile rheumatoid arthritis", "affects", "children"], ["Meloxicam", "used in", "children 2 years of age and older"], ["IV meloxicam", "has brand name", "Anjeso"], ["IV meloxicam", "has brand name", "Qamzova"], ["IV meloxicam", "has brand name", "Xifyrm"], ["IV meloxicam", "treats", "moderate to severe pain in adults"], ["IV meloxicam", "used in combination with", "non-NSAID analgesics"], ["Vivlodex capsules", "has brand name", "Vivlodex"], ["Vivlodex capsules", "used in", "adults"], ["Qmiiz ODT", "used in", "adults"], ["Qmiiz ODT", "used in", "children weighing at least 132 pounds (60 kilograms)"], ["Meloxicam", "has dosage form", "generic"]]
Relations: ["affects", "caused by", "causes", "has brand name", "has dosage form", "has drug class", "has mechanism of action", "is type of", "treats", "used in", "used in combination with"]
Answer:

completion:
affects: The subject condition or disease specifically impacts or occurs in the group or entity specified by the object entity.  
caused by: The subject condition or disease is caused by the process or condition specified by the object entity.  
causes: The subject condition or disease leads to or is associated with the symptom or effect specified by the object entity.  
has brand name: The subject drug or product is marketed under the brand name specified by the object entity.  
has dosage form: The subject drug is available in the pharmaceutical dosage form specified by the object entity.  
has drug class: The subject drug is classified under the pharmacological class specified by the object entity.  
has mechanism of action: The subject drug exerts its effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.  
is type of: The subject condition or disease is a specific type or subtype of the broader category specified by the object entity.  
treats: The subject drug is used to treat or manage the medical condition specified by the object entity.  
used in: The subject drug is indicated for use in the patient group or population specified by the object entity.  
used in combination with: The subject drug is administered alongside or in conjunction with the substance or drug specified by the object entity.
